outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured micrograph images (time-lapse of photoactivation), not a plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows scatter/line plots of normalized intensity vs. time (with fitted curves) and insets of averaged early time points with error bars presented as scatter points over time. These are scatter/line-type plots, which are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points, and the main plots already display the individual measured data points directly.
